nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Production Prompt Template
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 Production Prompt Template

[Optional I2V or first/last-frame instruction]

Use the supplied frame as the exact opening or ending composition. Continue naturally without an unwanted cut.

integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1] [Shot size and angle] of [subject identity and fixed appearance] in [specific environment]. The subject [one clear visible action] while facing [obstacle, pressure, or emotional change]. Performance: [brief physical beats].

Camera: [one clear movement or static]. 

Lighting and style: [time, light direction, colour, realism or animation style]. 

Keep [face, hair, clothing, prop, environment geometry, and screen direction] stable. [Optional dialogue: (S1) says <d>[English] Exact dialogue.</d>]

overall_soundscape:

[Room tone or outdoor ambience], [physical action sounds], [environment sounds], and [nonverbal vocal sounds]. Do not repeat dialogue here.

non_diegetic_music:

[Instrument, mood, tempo, dynamics, and ending] or N/A.

## Control checklist

- One main subject action
- One clear camera movement
- One emotional or story beat
- Stable identity, clothing, props, and background
- Dialogue short enough for the video duration
- Exact visible text inside straight quotation marks
- No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks unless required

Close-up on Link, exactly as in the opening frame, wearing his classic green tunic, brown leather belt, boots and carrying the Master Sword on his hand, walking to inside an ancient cross stone way illuminated by soft sun light. Link slowly walks toward Zelda, who is standing beside they way. She looks at him with concern and says in a calm but urgent voice:

"Link... you finally came."

A deep rumble suddenly shakes the temple, dust falls from the ceiling, and the blue light around them begins to fade.

Audio: mysterious ambient sound, low distant rumble, soft magical chimes, Zelda's voice close and clear in front of the mix, subtle stone debris falling in the background.
LOOP MODE: Node 94 extracts the last decoded frame. loop.py replaces node 53 (first_frame) with that frame and node 15 prompt for each ---LOOP--- section.
